conditions_and_layout_ranges: inherit exactly the reserved v11 line-specific independent ranges
action_rng: reseed each episode: independent_action_seed + condition_index*1000 + episode_index; shared across methods
deployment: sole existing target Actor, Polyak0.001; no online/target mixing

speed_reference.conditions: same three conditions, no additional action scale
speed_reference.purpose: Compare retained speed at descriptive comparable observed risk; historical age differs and no cross-seed/risk-equivalence claim

static_reset_failure: record nonadmitted with original seed; do not replace; report denominators
speed_interpretation: Only compare capped time including all failures, never success-only timing. Risk is descriptive observed rates, not equivalence.
training_risk_interpretation: new100K violations include every actual interaction and preheat; compare same-round control; retain cumulative successes and timeouts
